script_text: YOU RETURN SOMETHING. YOU DROP IT OFF. YOU GET THE SCAN. / AMAZON SAYS REFUND ISSUED... AND THE MONEY NEVER SHOWS UP ON YOUR CARD. / OR WORSE. IT SHOWS UP, AND THEN AMAZON CHARGES YOU AGAIN FOR THE SAME ITEM. / THAT HAS A NAME. IT IS CALLED A RETROCHARGE. / AND IT HAPPENED ENOUGH THAT AMAZON AGREED TO PAY $309.5 MILLION TO SETTLE A CLASS ACTION. / THAT WAS JANUARY, IN A FEDERAL COURT IN SEATTLE. AMAZON DENIES DOING ANYTHING WRONG. / BUT IT HAD ALREADY QUIETLY REFUNDED ABOUT $570 MILLION BEFORE THAT WAS EVEN FILED... / ...WITH ANOTHER $34 MILLION STILL GOING OUT THE DOOR. / AND IT REACHES ALL THE WAY BACK TO SEPTEMBER 2017. / STEVEN POPE, WHO RUNS MY AMAZON GUY, POSTED THAT AMAZON CREDITED HIM $1,798.81 FOR A TELEVISION HE RETURNED IN 2018. / HERE'S THE LATEST ON THAT SETTLEMENT RIGHT NOW.
